data.body: S5 PS3: fixed the LLM-Review BLOCKING finding — my concurrency project entry carried block_threshold:0.9 (+posture/exec) which effective_routing's per-key re-tune merge applied over the committed built-in overlay's 0.95, silently lowering its blocking calibration. RED-first: added test_project_concurrency_entry_does_not_retune_committed_block_threshold (asserts effective==committed==0.95) + tightened shape test to additive-only (set(entry)=={trigger_tokens,applies_to}) — both RED (0.9!=0.95). Fixed by stripping the entry to the two additive keys -> GREEN. Also addressed 2 advisories: made the contrast test HERMETIC via _make_repo fixture + added a glob-trigger assertion, and fixed the fixture path to src/rebar/_store/. Documented the additive-only discipline for built-in overlay ids. 33 trigger+recommend pass, 441 overlay/criteria pass, lint+typecheck 0. Amending + re-pushing.
